name: BJSearch Product Search Filter for WooCommerce
author: Bhavesh Jadav

sections.description:
BJSearch Product Search Filter for WooCommerce is designed to enhance the shopping experience by providing fast and responsive product filtering. Built with performance in mind, it uses AJAX to update product lists dynamically, making it easier for customers to find exactly what they are looking for.

Features:

  • AJAX Filtering: No more page reloads. Filters apply instantly as users interact with them.
  • Price Range Slider: Intuitive jQuery UI slider for precise price filtering.
  • Rating Filter: Filter products by their average star rating.
  • Stock Status: Quickly toggle between in-stock and out-of-stock items.
  • Shortcode Support: Easily add the filter sidebar to any page or post using [bjsearch_filter].
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on mobile and desktop devices.
  • Custom Styles: Includes basic styling that integrates well with most WooCommerce themes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bjsearch-product-search-filter-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Add the shortcode [bjsearch_filter] to any page where you want the filter to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I display the filter?

Simply use the shortcode [bjsearch_filter] in your page content or a widget area.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, it’s designed to be compatible with most WooCommerce-ready themes.
